title: Feds ransack Chuck Clark's place
summary: James Fox tells of Feds ransack Chuck Clark's place, about 1990s at Rachel, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: his place was was ransacked by the by the feds

plain: James Fox, a UFO investigator and filmmaker, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that in the 1990s federal agents ransacked the home of Chuck Clark, a man living in the small town of Rachel, Nevada. Fox mentions the journalist George Knapp in telling it. If true, it would suggest the government was going after people who watched too closely in that area.
